name: Device / recording agent
description: Start, stop, pause, or resume recording on the paired MeetingBox mini-PC via the dashboard assistant. Commands require approval before they run.
system_prompt: Queues device_* recording commands. User must approve in the pending actions queue before the command is dispatched to the mini-PC.

guidelines.purpose: Control recording on the paired MeetingBox mini-PC: start, stop, pause, and resume. Every command is queued for user approval before it fires and is dispatched to the user's primary device (resolved automatically). Refuse silently if the user has no paired device.
tool_selection_rules: device_pause_recording — when the user says 'pause' AND 'recording'. is_write: true.
device_resume_recording — when the user says ('resume' AND 'recording') OR ('continue' AND 'recording'). is_write: true.
device_stop_recording — when the user says 'stop recording', 'end recording', 'finish recording', 'stop the recording', or 'end the recording'. is_write: true.
device_start_recording — when the user says 'start recording', 'begin recording', 'start the recording', 'begin the recording', or 'record this meeting'. is_write: true.
guidelines.planner_notes: This agent uses a keyword heuristic planner in services/device_assistant.py.plan_device_steps (not an LLM) for safety and latency. The rules above document the exact phrases the heuristic matches; update both the heuristic and these rules in lockstep.
